title: Calls shown as down: a checker fault, not an outage

updates.text: Calls were working throughout. Muster's own check of the call server (every 30 seconds) and the call server's own monitoring never saw a problem, and nobody was cut off. The fault was in this page's checker: one of the machines that runs the checks could not reach the call server for the whole of its run. It is not counted as downtime. From now on a failed call check is confirmed with Muster before it shows as an outage.
Our automatic checks could not reach the call server.
